models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Automatic Run & Pinch Protection not adapted
Incorrect Window Motor / Door control module installed
stepByStepSolution: Adapt Automatic Run & Pinch Protection (see VAG Grubu Özel Servis ve Kronik Notları)
Verify the correct Window Motor(s)  / Door control module(s) are installed
technicalNotes:
Pinch Protection Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon Yapın: 
Make sure the window in question is completely closed.
Use the driver door window buttons to operate the window(s).
Roll down the window and keep holding the button down for 2 additional seconds after the window is already fully opened.
Roll up the window and keep holding the button up for 2 additional seconds after the window is already fully closed.
Now test the window automatic.
